highlights.title: US police officer pulls hair, throws punches during arrest in Arkansas
highlights.summary: Footage shows an Arkansas state patrol officer pulling a passenger by his hair and punching him during an arrest.

highlights.title: Protests as India’s Hindu nationalists take centre stage in New York

highlights.summary: Rebel fighters in Myanmar lose key towns as conscription, relentless air raids and Chinese support bolster the military.

highlights.summary: Mais de 3 mil pessoas seguem desaparecidas, segundo dados oficiais dos dois países

highlights.title: Sudanese repair roads by hand in Darfur to improve emergency access
highlights.summary: Residents of Golo in Sudan’s central Darfur are clearing and repairing a rugged road by hand to help emergency vehicles.

highlights.summary: As rescue efforts entered their fourth day, the scale of destruction came into focus, signaling a daunting recovery for the vulnerable nation.
